notes: Preamble + Article 1, full propositional coverage (R8), alignment keys (R9), structure fields and heading rows (R10). 21 rows. Re-adjudicated 2026-08-31 verb-first; see file header for the retyping table.

rows.because: a heading is a sign held over the region it opens — Relate (the name neither creates nor cuts the region; it stands over it) · Existence (the region's presence is what the name marks) at Ground grain (the object is a whole field of discourse). Every row whose ground is 'preamble' is read under it

rows.anchor: Preamble

rows.subject: recognition of the inherent dignity and of the equal and inalienable rights of all members of the human family
rows.object: the foundation of freedom, justice and peace in the world
rows.because: copula rule 3: a unique role (THE foundation) — standing-as one identified role
rows.anchor: is the foundation of freedom, justice and peace in the world

rows.subject: disregard and contempt for human rights
rows.object: barbarous acts which have outraged the conscience of mankind
rows.because: causation brings a class of acts into being — Generate·Existence at pattern grain; object kept whole per R4 though its relative clause has its own row (R8)
rows.anchor: have resulted in barbarous acts

rows.subject: barbarous acts
rows.because: outraging a conscience diminishes a moral standing — Differentiate (the standing is marred, nothing made or merely related) · Interpretation (a conscience bears moral meaning) on one identified standing
rows.resolution: relative pronoun "which" → barbarous acts, the head it restricts

alternate.because: readable as marring an arrangement rather than a meaning

rows.anchor: which have outraged the conscience of mankind

rows.subject: the advent of a world in which human beings shall enjoy freedom of speech and belief and freedom from fear and want
rows.object: the highest aspiration of the common people
rows.because: proclaiming-as assigns a bounded standing to one thing — Differentiate·Interpretation at figure grain

alternate.because: readable as a public sign emitted rather than a boundary drawn

rows.anchor: has been proclaimed as the highest aspiration of the common people

rows.subject: human beings
rows.object: freedom of speech and belief and freedom from fear and want
rows.because: RE-TYPED 2026-08-31 (was CON·Pattern, assigned by bucket): the object names a CONDITION (freedom), not a constituent part — to enjoy a freedom is to have that condition present and held, the verbal form of 'are free to speak' (copula rule 4's property predication): Relate·Existence at pattern grain. Contrast 'endowed WITH reason', where the object is a constituent faculty (part-whole → Structure → CON)

alternate.because: the prior reading: possession as a standing arrangement

rows.anchor: in which human beings shall enjoy freedom of speech and belief

rows.subject: that human rights should be protected by the rule of law
rows.because: extraposed subject clause + property adjective (copula rule 4); deontic "should" noted, does not move the phasepost (A3)
rows.anchor: that human rights should be protected by the rule of law

rows.subject: human rights
rows.because: protection is a standing guard-arrangement of the law over the rights — Relate (the law neither creates nor removes the rights; it stands over them) · Structure (a coverage arrangement between two relata) at pattern grain (a standing order, not one event)
rows.anchor: human rights should be protected by the rule of law

rows.subject: man
rows.relation: is not to be compelled to have recourse
rows.because: RE-TYPED 2026-08-31 (was CON·Pattern, justified circularly from a derived stance name). Verb-first: compulsion is CAUSATIVE — unnegated, the clause asserts man driven into rebellion, the same causation shape as this Preamble's own 'disregard HAS RESULTED IN barbarous acts' (oppression producing rebellion as rights-violation produced barbarism): Generate·Existence at pattern grain (generic man, a standing scenario). Polarity − per R6 — the condition is that this generation NOT occur; the window's only negation

alternate.because: the prior reading: a binding force-relation between circumstance and agent

rows.anchor: if man is not to be compelled to have recourse

rows.subject: to promote the development of friendly relations between nations
rows.because: extraposed subject + property adjective (copula rule 4)
rows.anchor: it is essential to promote the development of friendly relations between nations

rows.subject: the peoples of the United Nations
rows.object: their faith in fundamental human rights, in the dignity and worth of the human person and in the equal rights of men and women
rows.because: a held commitment restated, not a frame replaced: the object is literally 'their faith', and reaffirming holds the holder to it again — Relate·Interpretation at figure grain. REC (Generate·Interpretation, the re-zero: converted, recanted, revised) concedes a prior ground; reaffirmation concedes nothing. 'in the Charter' is adjunct (A2)

alternate.because: the prior reading, kept disclosed: the RE- prefix read as a re-grounding act

rows.anchor: have in the Charter reaffirmed their faith in fundamental human rights

rows.subject: the peoples of the United Nations
rows.object: to promote social progress and better standards of life in larger freedom
rows.because: forming a resolution bounds a course of action, cutting off the others — Differentiate·Interpretation on one resolve; the infinitival complement stays inside the object (A1)
rows.resolution: coordinated predicate shares "the peoples of the United Nations"

alternate.because: readable as generating a new commitment

rows.anchor: have determined to promote social progress and better standards of life in larger freedom

rows.subject: Member States
rows.object: the promotion of universal respect for and observance of human rights and fundamental freedoms
rows.because: a pledge places the pledger and an undertaking into one standing link — Relate (the undertaking is neither performed nor defined by pledging; the pledger is held to it) · Structure (a link between two relata) at figure grain (one specific commitment); the infinitival complement stays inside the object (A1)
rows.anchor: Member States have pledged themselves to achieve

rows.subject: a common understanding of these rights and freedoms
rows.object: of the greatest importance for the full realization of this pledge
rows.because: copula + property (rule 4)
rows.anchor: is of the greatest importance for the full realization of this pledge

rows.subject: The General Assembly
rows.object: this Universal Declaration of Human Rights as a common standard of achievement for all peoples and all nations
rows.because: declaring the Declaration's standing — a bounded public act of definition. The operative act the seven whereas-premises support (R10's role field is what carries that argument structure)
rows.resolution: subject stands in its own preceding paragraph ("Now, therefore, The General Assembly" / blank line / "Proclaims…") — the Preamble's own layout, not a pronoun
rows.anchor: Proclaims this Universal Declaration of Human Rights as a common standard of achievement

rows.subject: every individual and every organ of society
rows.object: to promote respect for these rights and freedoms and by progressive measures, national and international, to secure their universal and effective recognition and observance
rows.because: RE-TYPED 2026-08-31 (was CON·Pattern, typed off 'prescribed standing conduct' — the deontic frame, not the verb, inverting A3). Verb-first: the conative 'strive' wraps 'to PROMOTE respect' — fostering a valuation in others, by teaching and education — and the product is an interpretive stance across society, not an arrangement: Generate·Interpretation at pattern grain (every individual and organ, standing labour). Typed from the verb; that this re-occupies a previously empty cell is a consequence, not a reason. English folds 'to secure their recognition' into the same striving (A1) where Spanish and Mandarin verb it separately — see prop udhr:secure-recognition

alternate.because: the prior reading: prescribed standing conduct

rows.anchor: shall strive by teaching and education to promote respect for these rights and freedoms

rows.subject: every individual and every organ of society
rows.because: a content held by a holder — Relate·Interpretation; "constantly" makes it habitual, hence Pattern
rows.resolution: participial subject shared with the purpose clause's "every individual and every organ of society"
rows.anchor: keeping this Declaration constantly in mind
